description: This file contains the MeasuringUtil class, a utility class providing static methods to measure the execution time of code blocks using Spring's StopWatch and Java functional interfaces.

classes.name: MeasuringUtil
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to perform performance measurements of code execution blocks, supporting Runnable, Supplier, Consumer, and BiConsumer functional interfaces.

methods.name: measure
methods.description: Overloaded methods to measure the execution time of code: one takes a Runnable, another takes a Supplier with a Consumer or BiConsumer to process the duration and result.
